title: perf(objectql)!: a cascade delete removes a relation's children as one predicate delete per chunk
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"zhuangjianguo"} -->
_Requested by **Steedos** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_018ETKaNwMZCNRYD7D8Q9Ubb?thread=cmsg_018ETKaNwMZCNRYD7D8Q9UbbGfxE9QQTsFJp457cGiCViY)_

Fixes #33699

Clause-②: no (narrowing) — the published hook dispatch shape for cascaded children changes (`dispatch.mode` 'record' → 'per-row', `options.multi`, before-hooks run before the set delete); BREAKING banner + ADR-0087 disposition in the changeset; one CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER review owed before the queue
Metadata-protocol: none
Skills-docs: none — no `skills/**` file teaches a cascaded child's `dispatch.mode`, `referentialCascadeDelete` or a sibling-count hook (`git grep` of `dispatch.mode`, `referentialCascadeDelete` and `per-row` over `skills/`: the only hits teach predicate writes in general and stay true); the spec's own hook docs are updated here

**Landing waits on #33782** (the id-shaped vs predicate-shaped delete scope parity pins): ruling 6893661036 precondition (1) says it merges before or together with this PR. A CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER review is owed on the narrowing face; the seat area arranges it.

## 维护者速读

- **改了什么**:删除一条记录时,级联删除的子记录不再逐条删除,而是每 500 条一批、一条 `DELETE … WHERE id IN (…)` 删掉;每个子记录的删除前钩子、实时事件、回收站、权限拒绝回滚都保留。
- **为什么改**:删除一个带 10 条明细的商机,今天要 155 条 SQL,随明细数线性增长;本 PR 实测降到 57 条(SQLite 与 PostgreSQL 相同),中位耗时约减半。
- **风险与回滚**:级联子记录的钩子上下文从 `dispatch.mode: 'record'` 变为 `'per-row'`(带 `options.multi`),且同批子记录的删除前钩子全部先跑、再统一删除;在删除前钩子里数"剩余兄弟记录"的应用钩子会看到它们都还在。调用者无权删除的子记录会退回今天的逐条删除,照旧拒绝并整体回滚。回滚 = revert 本 PR。
- **先看**:`packages/objectql/src/engine-cascade-planning.ts`(`deleteCascadedChildren`,批量与逐条退回)、`packages/objectql/src/engine-delete-and-aggregate.ts`(谓词删除分支里的范围核对与逐行实时事件)、`packages/plugins/plugin-auth/src/last-admin-guard.test.ts` 末尾(最后管理员守卫在两种形状下结论一致)。
- **两分钟验证**:`pnpm --filter @objectstack/objectql exec vitest run src/engine-cascade-delete-batch.test.ts`,预期 10 个用例全绿。
- **需要你做的**:等 #33782 合入后,由席位安排契约复审(CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER)再落地。

## What changes

Ruling 6893661036 (option F1), replacing point 4 of ruling 6893104201; points 1–3 stand.

- **The walk** (`engine-cascade-planning.ts`): for a `cascade` relation the walk now collects the relation's dependents across the whole root set and hands them to `deleteCascadedChildren`, which issues ONE predicate delete per chunk of 500 (`REFERENCE_PROBE_BATCH`, under `MAX_BULK_PER_ROW_HOOK_ROWS` = 10,000) through the public `delete()`: `where: { id: { $in: chunk } }`, `multi: true`. The chunk therefore runs every child's `beforeDelete` (per-row, ADR-0058 Addendum II), one `deleteMany`, then every child's `afterDelete`. A child's own children are walked by the predicate arm's existing `cascadeDeleteRelations` (#27004), joining the root's set, so grandchildren are batched too.
- **The marker** (`engine-top-level.ts`, `engine-middleware-and-context.ts`, surface amendment 6893212568): the cascade-issued token gains an optional id set, and `claimReferentialCascadeDelete` matches a predicate delete whose `where` is exactly `{ id: { $in } }` naming that set. Every per-row context, both phases, carries `referentialCascadeDelete: true`.
- **Security parity, point 2** (`engine-delete-and-aggregate.ts`): a claimed cascade batch always reads its doomed rows through the middleware-composed AST. If a requested child is missing (a scope that narrows a predicate delete where it refuses the by-id one), the engine throws an engine-internal `CascadeBatchNarrowed` before any hook or write; the walk catches only that and deletes the chunk by id, so the caller meets today's refusal and envelope and the cascade rolls back. A driver with no `deleteMany` (or a floored external driver) keeps the by-id path. One cascade can show both shapes.
- **Realtime, point 1**: a cascade batch publishes one `data.record.deleted` per child from its pre-image, never the bulk `data.records.deleted`.
- **Point 3**: no new refusal; the bulk per-row hook ceiling is asserted only when the child has delete-side hooks, and a chunk never exceeds 500.
- **Spec prose**: the `HookContext.dispatch.mode` and `referentialCascadeDelete` TSDoc now say a cascaded child is `'per-row'` with `multi`, and that the token can name an id set. No `.describe()` and no schema shape changed (`check:docs` green, nothing regenerated).
- **SQL shape emitted** (SQLite driver log, `DEBUG=knex:query`, warm delete): inside the transaction, one doomed read `select * from bench_line_item where id in (?, x10)`, then one `delete from bench_line_item where id in (?, x10)`; the sharing cleanup now runs once per chunk (`select/delete from sys_record_share … record_id in (?, x10)`, same for `sys_share_link`); the audit pair stays per child.

## Tests

- `packages/objectql/src/engine-cascade-delete-batch.test.ts` (new, 10 cases, a driver that rolls back for real and logs its writes): before x N → one `deleteMany` → after x N with the write count observed from inside each hook; `dispatch.mode: 'per-row'`, `index` 0..N-1, `options.multi`, `previous` = own row, the marker on every per-row context; the sibling-count flip (`[3, 3, 3]`); grandchildren batched and marked; 501 children = two set deletes (500 + 1); realtime per-row; rollback on a before-phase and an after-phase refusal; the narrowed-chunk fallback (today's 403 envelope, nothing deleted, only `'record'` dispatches ran); an allowed fallback keeping today's shape beside a batched relation in the same cascade; no `deleteMany` keeps by-id.
- `packages/plugins/plugin-auth/src/last-admin-guard.test.ts`, new top-level `describe` `[F1]`: the shipped last-administrator membership guard on a real SQLite engine, each case run on the batch AND on the walk's by-id path: a cascade removing both administrative memberships is refused (403 `PERMISSION_DENIED`, `object: sys_member`) with nothing deleted on both legs; a cascade sparing another administrator is allowed on both legs.
- `packages/objectql/src/engine-cascade-summary-rollback.test.ts`: one expectation re-triaged (see Acceptance notes).

## Acceptance notes

- The one fixture re-triaged: on a runtime that cannot roll back, a refusal raised after a chunk's set delete (a failed roll-up recompute) now finds the whole chunk deleted, where the per-child walk had deleted only the children before the refusal. The changeset says so.
- Not done here, from ruling 6893104201's c1: the walk's collect probe, re-probe and the recycle-bin snapshot still read the same child rows (statements 22, 24, 25 of the capture). Behaviour-neutral, left for a follow-up.
- "Never more rows" (a predicate scope admitting a child the by-id gate refuses) cannot be detected by the missing-id check; that direction is #33782's pin.
- Surface: the plugin-auth test is outside the claim's objectql file surface; the dispatch's proof list orders it, and objectql cannot import plugin-auth.

## Verification

Head `89dff98f6` (origin/main merged twice; the second merge touched objectql transactions, so the objectql suite was re-run on it). Bench numbers are from my own runs of `packages/qa/dogfood/bench/sql-perf/bench.mjs --scale 100000 --only cascade_delete_opportunity` on this box (shared, 5 deletes each, one opportunity with 10 line items, admin): statement counts exact, milliseconds indicative. "Before" = objectql source at base `1e65a389e` built into the same tree; "after" = this branch.

| dialect | before statements | after statements | before p50 / p95 ms | after p50 / p95 ms (run 1 · run 2) |
|:--|--:|--:|:--|:--|
| SQLite | 155 (166 cold) | 57 (68 cold) | 131.2 / 169.7 | 66.4 / 115.2 · 76.1 / 148.5 |
| PostgreSQL 16 (private cluster, fsync off) | 155 (166 cold) | 57 (68 cold) | 243.0 / 312.5 | 89.5 / 166.3 · 85.3 / 145.3 |

<details><summary>Local suites and gates</summary>

- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/objectql exec vitest run` at `89dff98f6`: Test Files 598 passed (598), Tests 13168 passed (13168); VERDICT command-exit 0. objectql `typecheck` at `89dff98f6` exit 0.
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/plugin-auth exec vitest run` at `a1e04815b`: Test Files 277 passed (277), Tests 5472 passed, 10 skipped; VERDICT command-exit 0. At `89dff98f6`: `last-admin-guard.test.ts` + `remove-user-atomicity.test.ts`, 120 passed.
- `typecheck`: objectql exit 0 (test layer 39 files / 233 errors held, unchanged), plugin-auth exit 0; spec `check:test-typecheck` exit 0.
- `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands`: 96 families, all run at `cb2cafef6`; 94 exit 0. `check:query-options-erasure` exit 1 (test surface 236 to 237, an `as any` on an option bag in the new test) fixed in `d31c13d0a`, re-run exit 0. `check:dual-build-cjs-loads` exit 3 (prerequisite: not every package built here), NOT MEASURED, CI's. `--ran` reconciliation: 96 derived, 96 run, 0 unrun.
- At `d31c13d0a` with this body as the event: `check-adr-0087-registration` 0, `check-changeset-no-major` 0, `check-closing-keyword-parity` 0, `check-empty-changeset` 0, `check-partof-closing-keyword` 0; plus `check:nul-bytes`, `check:cross-package-test-inputs`, `check:test-source-alias`, `check:doc-authoring`, `check:issue-citations` all 0; eslint over the eight touched files exit 0.
- Spec: `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec check:generated` after a spec build: every artifact current (`check:docs` green; TSDoc only, nothing regenerated).

</details>

<details><summary>Ablations (each red, then restored to HEAD's blob, git diff HEAD empty)</summary>

All through `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs` (anchor 1 to 0, blob moved, restored).

1. Delete the `CascadeBatchNarrowed` throw: the narrowed child is silently skipped and the parent delete succeeds. 2 of 10 red ("expected undefined to be 'PERMISSION_DENIED'"; the both-shapes case).
2. Make the token never match an id set (`if (issued.ids != null) return undefined`): 5 of 10 red (the marker, realtime and fallback all key on the claim). A first attempt whose replacement contained its anchor was refused by the tool as a no-op and re-run.
3. Route the batch back to the bulk realtime event: 1 of 10 red (`['data.records.deleted']` instead of three `data.record.deleted`).
4. Dispatch the batch's before-hooks without `multi` (the "record shape, batched befores" the ruling rejects), objectql rebuilt so plugin-auth's dist import carries it: `[batch] … BOTH administrative memberships is refused` red ("promise resolved true instead of rejecting": the guard judged each membership with its sibling still present and the last administrators were deleted). Restored, rebuilt, `ablation-dist-preflight --absent` ok, 4 of 4 green.

</details>
